headline.caveat: multi-year commitment; duration and minimum-spend structure undisclosed

nature_md: Announced Dec 2025: a multi-year, $200M partnership making Anthropic's Claude models available natively in Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake Intelligence across all three major clouds, to Snowflake's 12,600+ customers, plus a joint go-to-market initiative around deploying AI agents on governed enterprise data. Snowflake is deliberately model-agnostic — it signed a parallel $200M deal with OpenAI two months later — so this is a wholesale/resale arrangement, not exclusivity. App-layer deals like this are the test of AI revenue quality: enterprise dollars flowing to labs through platforms, unconnected to any circular financing.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Committed model-access spend — cost of revenue against Snowflake's Cortex AI consumption products; Snowflake monetizes by reselling model calls with platform markup inside customer credits.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: For Anthropic: high-quality third-party revenue (committed floor, usage upside) recognized over the term — the kind of demand bulls cite against the circularity critique, since Snowflake is neither investor nor supplier.
